Bill.BriefDescription: Directing the military department to acquire and maintain a supply of antiviral medication.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to antiviral medication; and adding a new sectionto chapter 38.52 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 38.52 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The department shall acquire and maintain a ready supply ofantiviral medication to ensure the availability of a full course oftherapy to twentyfive percent of the population of the state during anepidemic emergency. In determining the necessary quantity for thesupply, the department shall consider any federal supplies of antiviralmedications that have been allocated to the state to offset the amountthat the department must acquire and maintain. (2) The reserve supply of antiviral medication may only be accessedand distributed to the public upon the governor's declaration thatthere is a severe outbreak of influenza or other infectious disease.
